correctStatements.text: At 07:10 tara saw European monitors green again.
At 07:02 uri saw lookups succeed from our resolvers.
At 06:55 vik recreated the CNAME with TTL 60 seconds.
At 06:52 wen decided to recreate the CNAME record by hand.
At 06:43 uri saw the DNS lookup for api.example.test return NXDOMAIN.
At 06:40 tara reported external monitors show api.example.test unreachable from Europe.
Vik found a DNS change was applied at 06:30 by the migration script.
Vik said the script deleted the CNAME record instead of updating it.
Tara said the outage lasted roughly 40 minutes for clients using cached NXDOMAIN.
Action item: make the migration script dry run by default, owner vik.
Action item: add a DNS record count check to monitoring, owner uri.
Wen closed it and summarised that the migration script removed the API CNAME record, restored by hand.
